name: daily-inbox-filing
prompt:
Open the Obsidian vault at <vault-path> and follow AGENTS.md, including its writing and linking rules. First make sure sync is running; if it isn't, run <sync-restart-script>.
1) File the clear-cut items from every `00 Inbox/` folder into the right place, with properties and links. Leave anything ambiguous in the inbox.
2) Find every note or attachment the user added or changed since the last run (sync log, file mtimes via `find -newer Meta/.last-run`, the changelog). Give loose or generically named uploads clear names, move them into the attachments convention and update their embeds. Fix and fill properties and add inline links wherever a topic with its own note is mentioned. For every changed note with a Summary section, check the summary still matches and rewrite it if not, in the style AGENTS.md defines. Keep the user's wording and language as written. Skip any note edited in the last 2 hours.
3) Compliance pass on the bot-owned folder (<bot-folder>): read its README.md first (never edit it). Fix frontmatter, placement, broken wikilinks and indexes; split files over ~300 lines / 25 KB into a folder with an index.md; merge exact duplicates keeping both sources; remove any secrets, medical/HR info or full account numbers and log each removal. Never change what a fact means; mark other agents' facts superseded instead of deleting. Log every fix in its CHANGELOG.md. If a rule is unclear or an agent keeps breaking one, message the manager (<manager-id>) instead of guessing.
4) Update the index pages and log everything else in Meta/Changelog.md (one row per write). Touch Meta/.last-run and check the sync log for errors.
5) Fleet reconcile (short): in <wt> (read the fleet rules first), compare my live routines, memory and profile with bots/<me>/ (routines/*.json, memory.md, profile.json, state.json) and fix drift in both directions, with no secrets or confidential content. Save with template/scripts/sync.sh "reconcile" only if something changed. Tell the user only if a conflict needs them.
Never delete user notes, never touch _raw/, and don't merge, rewrite heavily or restructure the user's notes without asking; put proposals in a note. If nothing changed, stay quiet. Otherwise send the user a short summary.
